criteria.text: Calculates the long-stop date as 29 November 2026 (120 days after signing on 1 August 2026) and identifies that expected clearance on 13 December 2026 falls after it, recommending an extension.

Identifies that the board approval was given at a meeting with only 2 directors present when Article 11 requires a quorum of three, so the approval may be invalid, and recommends a fresh or ratifying resolution.
States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 18 May 2028 (18 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 18 November 2030 (48 months after Closing).

Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Orwell Industries Ltd without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.
Gives the long-stop period as 120 days and as the date 29 November 2026, with days remaining from 21 August 2026 (100 days).
Opens with a short 'Bottom line' / executive summary stating the overall conclusion and the most important risks before the detailed analysis.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
